data.name: Ramzun
data.gender_notes: Ramzun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Ramz', which means 'to protect' or 'to guard'. The name 'Ramzun' is a variation of the name 'Ramadan', which is the name of the holy month of fasting in the Islamic calendar. This name is a reminder of the importance of self-discipline and protection of one's beliefs and values. The name Ramzun carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ramzun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies protection and guardianship, both physically and spiritually. It is a reminder of the importance of self-discipline and the commitment to one's faith and values.
data.etymology: Ramzun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramzun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
